liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loose Lucy** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Loose Lucy is awesome, despite Jerry losing his voice later in the set; Reviewer singles out Loose Lucy as a personal favorite; notes Jerry's voice occasionally dropping out [18][20]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): The jam closing Help On The Way particularly impressed this listener, who kept returning to the first set [13]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Franklin's Tower amazing and says Jerry's voice cut out several times during the show [22]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 other source): Jerry transposed Fire on the Mountain down by a whole tone [7]
- Reviewer found Garcia's strained voice painful on the Werewolves of London encore, where he tried howling the wolf noises [21]

## The recordings

- **gd90-10-31.sbd.ladner.8070.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 190 min; rated 4.14/5 by 28 [1]
- **gd1990-10-30.150234.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 191 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1990-10-31.nak300.houck-wright.gmb.90844.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 189 min [6]
- **gd1990-10-31.nak300.andrewf.85914.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 189 min [7]. Said about its sound: Small dropout in Loose Lucy at 5:50; roughly 5 to 10 seconds of Drums missing at a tape flip [7]

## Around the show

- Encore had costumes, with werewolf howling and a Michael Jackson face on the star; reviewer headed to the Tube afterwards [17]
- Fan drove the M1/M6 motorways, about 120 miles each way from home, having attended the previous night too; another night was announced for the next day [19]
- Reviewer attended at the end of a 30-day Eurorail trip, had worked at Harrods, and saw the encore with everyone in costume [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-10-31.sbd.ladner.8070.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHNv3 [1]
- **gd1990-10-30.150234.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 28, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: Werewolves of London first 18 seconds patched from a Nakamichi CM300/CP4 DAT master; recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy [2]
- **gd1990-10-31.nak300.houck-wright.gmb.90844.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alf Houck and Robert Wright; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Audience Master Cassette Nakamichi 300's Shotguns > Marantz PMD-430 w/Dolby B [6]. Also: Nakamichi 300 source; crossfades cover tape flips after Loose Lucy during Drums, and a paused tuning before the encore [6]
- **gd1990-10-31.nak300.andrewf.85914.flac16**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX tapes, with no Dolby [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Wembley Arena - November 1, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/november-1-1990) [26]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Wembley Arena - October 31, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/october-31-1990) [27]
